title: Rename Google Stackdriver operators and hook to Cloud Monitoring
body:
Renames the Google provider's Stackdriver hook, operators and links to Cloud Monitoring, matching the
API they call. Old class names remain as deprecated aliases (planned removal March 31, 2027).

Part of the rename tracked in #61009. The task log handler follows in a separate PR.

This also removes an unreachable `except HttpError` clause in `delete_alert_policy` and
`delete_notification_channel` that re-raised as `AirflowException`. It was left over from before the
gapic migration: the underlying `monitoring_v3.AlertPolicyServiceClient` /
`NotificationChannelServiceClient` are gRPC clients that raise `google.api_core.exceptions.*`, never
`googleapiclient.errors.HttpError`, so the clause never matched. Callers — including user retry and
failure callbacks reading `context["exception"]` — already saw the raw `google.api_core` exception
before this change, so there is no observable behaviour change.

related: #61009
